ideas.title: The Minnesota Medicaid Scandal and the Fallout, Explained
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged $9 billion in Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the Trump administration's response
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How did the Trump administration respond to the allegations?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the alleged $9 billion in Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the Trump administration's response. It would involve following the money and analyzing the impact on Minnesota's healthcare system.
